images.filename: StateLibQld 1 54416 Bullock team outside James McKenzie's General Store at Blackall, Queensland, ca.1885.jpg
images.caption:
Bullock team outside James McKenzie's General Store at Blackall, Queensland, ca.1885
Loaded wagons and bullock teams waiting outside the James McKenzie General Store. The store is a timber framed weatherboard building with a corrugated iron roof in a bungalow style and a verandah . The sign on the store front reads 'Wholesale & Retail James McKenzie General Store'.
images.alt:
Bullock team outside James McKenzie's General Store at Blackall, Queensland, ca.1885
Loaded wagons and bullock teams waiting outside the James McKenzie General Store. The store is a timber framed weatherboard building with a corrugated iron roof in a bungalow style and a verandah . The sign on the store front reads 'Wholesale & Retail James McKenzie General Store'.
